NOTE
**Still not ready: the PR template is incomplete and an open PR already covers the same issue**

New: The author rebased (size unchanged) and says it addresses #37647, so the earlier "open an issue first" feedback is moot because that issue exists. Missing: "Fixes: #37647" and any testing notes or before/after screenshots for this UI change (the description says only "code analysis"). Open PR #39267 also targets the same issue, and nothing here says whether #37647 has "help wanted".

###### Next step

Keep "not ready"; once the template is filled in and the duplicate with #39267 is sorted out, hand it to apoorvapendse for review.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the rebase! The issue exists, so no need to file a new one, but please keep "not ready" for now: add "Fixes: #37647" and include how you tested this with before/after screenshots, as described in the [reviewable PR guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html). Please also check how this differs from the open PR #39267 on the same issue.
```
